chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

You will not be righteous until you recognize, and you will not recognize until you ratify, and you will not ratify until you submit to the four doors; the first of them is not correct except by the last one. The companions of the three strayed and wandered with a far wandering.

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, accepts only the righteous deed, and Allah accepts not except with fulfillment of the conditions and covenants. And whoever fulfills Allah's conditions and completes what is described in His covenant, attains what is with Him, and He completes His promise.

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, informed the servants of the way of guidance and established for them the minarets therein, and informed them how to travel, so He said: 'And I am Forgiving to him who repents and believes and does righteous deeds, then follows the right Guidance.'

And He said: 'Indeed, Allah accepts only from the pious.' So whoever fears Allah, Mighty and Majestic, in what He commanded, will meet Allah, Mighty and Majestic, as a believer in what Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) brought.
Far be it! Far be it! A people have perished and died before they were guided, and they thought that they were believing, and they associated (partners) from where they did not know.
Indeed, whoever comes to the houses from their doors is guided, and whoever takes in other than them travels upon the road of perdition.

Allah linked the obedience of the Guardian of His command with the obedience of His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family), and the obedience of His Messenger with obedience to him. So whoever neglects the obedience of the Masters of Command, neither obeyed Allah nor His Messenger, and this is the acknowledgement of what was revealed from the presence of Allah.
Take your adornment at every Masjid.
And seek the houses which Allah has allowed to be exalted and that His Name may be mentioned in them.

For He has informed you that they are men whom neither merchandise nor selling diverts from the Remembrance of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and the keeping up of Salat and the giving of Zakat; they fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes shall be overturned.
Indeed, Allah had selected the Messengers for His command. Then He selected them as ratifiers to that regarding the warning.
And there is not a community but a warner has gone among them.
The one who was ignorant strayed, and the one who had insight and intellect was guided.
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is Saying: 'For surely it is not the eyes that are blind, but blind are the hearts which are in the chests.'
And how can he be guided, the one who does not see, and how can he see, the one who was not warned.

Follow the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and acknowledge with what was revealed from the presence of Allah, and follow the effects of the guidance, for they are signs of the entrustments and the piety.
And know! If a man were to deny Isa (peace be upon him) ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) and acknowledge with the ones besides him from the Messengers, he would not have believed.
Shorten the way by seeking the Minarets, and seek from behind the veils, the effect which would perfect the matter of your religion, and believe in Allah, your Lord.

key_terms.عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْمَ: Isa ibn Maryam (Jesus son of Mary)

ai.seo_question: What are the four doors of faith and how does obedience to the Imams relate to obedience to Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi elucidates the hierarchical structure of faith, positing that true righteousness (Salih) is contingent upon a sequential progression through recognition (Ma'rifah), ratification (Tasdiq), and submission (Taslim). It underscores the Shia doctrine of 'Tawalli' and 'Tabarri' by linking obedience to the Imams directly to obedience to Allah and the Prophet, warning that those who neglect the 'doors' of guidance—specifically the Imams—stray into deep error despite the clarity of divine signs.
